description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing favorite destinations for users, including listing, adding, and removing favorites, using FastAPI framework with SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: FavoriteOut
classes.description: Schema representing a favorite destination, used for response serialization.

classes.name: DeleteResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a delete operation response indicating success.

methods.name: list[FavoriteOut] list_favorites( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all favorites for the current user.

methods.name: FavoriteOut add_favorite( payload: FavoriteCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new favorite destination for the current user.

methods.name: DeleteResponse remove_favorite( favorite_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a favorite by ID for the current user.

calls: select(Destination.id).join(Trip, Destination.trip_id == Trip.id).where(Destination.id == payload.destination_id, Trip.user_id == current_user.id)
